steps.domain_action: Define base field F = Q(sqrt 4190205) with class group [32, 2]
Apply conductor rule v2(d)+1 to obtain exponent 12
Trace 2-adic filtration from k=3 to k=11
Branch between Candidate A and Candidate B based on ramification at infinity
Candidate A assumes conductor 4096 with unramified infinite places
Observe Candidate A produces a totally real field for the fiducial coordinates
Candidate B assumes conductor 2048 with ramified infinite places
Observe Candidate B produces the required complex coordinates for the SIC fiducial
Compare the cyclic quotients of order 1024 from both candidates
Rejoin the candidates at the point of fiducial coordinate generation
Identify that the fiducial coordinates are complex and not totally real
Fix Candidate B as the correct field identification
Seal the SIC ray class field K as the definitive coordinate host
